{{Otheruses|Promenade}}
The '''Sunfruit Promenade''' was a lounge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. It was on a roofed patio flanked by a flower garden. The establishment took its name from the [[sunfruit]].<ref name="ws">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]], [[Yokel Group]] treated some of the crewmen of the [[Hawkbat (starship)|''Hawkbat'']], a [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], to drinks in order to gather information.<ref name="ws" />
